decision: Pass for the requested grammar-clarity correction; author acceptance is not claimed.
request: Abolish compressed inline grammar explanation prose throughout the book, including subject-to-be/contraction chains and same-line Usually/Now contrasts.

required: Use real tables with explicit column and row relationships for forms, spelling, contractions and meanings.
Use aligned complete example sentences for positive, negative and question forms and for contextual contrasts.
Use genuine spatial word movement or insertion diagrams where they teach a transformation.
Preserve readable 10 pt ordinary teaching models and the established functional label roles.
prohibited: Inline subject-to-form arrow chains joined with middle dots or slash-delimited rule fragments.
Contraction lists presented as punctuation chains rather than aligned full models.
Same-line Usually/Now explanations that hide the contrast in prose.
Formulaic plus-rules used as explanatory prose.
retained: Accurate existing charts and pictorial meaning diagrams.
Genuine spatial arrows, word movement and insertion, timelines, and task-serving maps.
Authentic readings, dialogue, task directions, questions, source facts and response models.

resolved_changes: 7B date models separated into Month/Year/Date cells and a separate complete Question/Answer pair.
Regular-past lexical reference arranged in two parallel Verb/Past tables.
Irregular-past lexical reference arranged as Verb/Past/Useful chunk columns.
Cold lexical distinction arranged in an explicit Word/Meaning chart.

limits: This evidence records the requested grammar clarity correction, not a redesign or independent regrade of every activity.
No new subjective audio review was performed. Existing audio, media and answer-key content was preserved.
Publication and live-site release verification are handled separately by the parent task.
No author approval or final acceptance by the user is claimed.
